items.q: Will these hashtags make my post go viral?
items.a: No tool can promise that. Hashtags help people find a post, but reach depends mostly on your content, timing and how people react to it.

items.q: Can I use the captions as they are?
items.a: Add your own voice, a real detail and one clear call to action. Posts with a personal touch perform better than generic ones.

items.q: Can your team manage my Instagram or LinkedIn?
items.a: Yes. Our social media team plans, creates and posts content, and reports on enquiries.
